articles.headline: Prime Video plans to invest more than $2 billion in Latin America
articles.summary: Amazon’s streaming unit plans a major expansion across Mexico, Brazil, Argentina, Colombia, and Chile through 2030. For businesses, the move signals continued pressure in regional media, sports rights, advertising, and cloud-backed digital content competition.

articles.headline: Marvell gives Google option to buy a $12.2 billion stake in custom AI chip deal
articles.summary: The deal underscores how hyperscalers are locking in custom silicon to control AI infrastructure costs and supply. That matters for enterprises because it can reshape cloud pricing, chip demand, and the balance of power in AI infrastructure.

articles.headline: AI data startup Micro1 reaches $500 million gross run rate amid AI training boom
articles.summary: Micro1’s rapid scale points to continued enterprise demand for data and model-training infrastructure. Businesses tracking AI adoption should note the strength of the training ecosystem, which can influence vendor availability, pricing, and project timelines.
